notes.title: Promotional Activities is coming & 0210 update annoucement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The adventure of Kroos is about to start a discount at 10 a.m. in Pacific, the specific discount offers are as follows:

2.10 10:00 to 2.15 09:54, 32% off discount.

2.16 09:55 to 2.19 10:05, 52% off discount.

2.19 10:06 to 2.24 10:00, 32% off discount.

2.24 10:00 resumed the original price.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

2.10 update announcement:

1. Optimize the part of the UI interface to improve the experience.

2. Add more resolutions to choose from. (it may affect the old archive, such as the wrong resolution after entering the game, choose again, if there is any inconvenience, please understand).

3. Adjusted the AI of each boss.


M.J.H.X. Studio

notes.title: 32% off for the next 2 weeks and extra 20% off during the Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

<<The adventure of Kroos>> is about to offer a 32% discount on Steam from 10:00 a.m. on February 10th Pacific to 10:00 a.m. on February 24th Pacific.

To celebrate the upcoming Lunar New Year with all of you, we will offer you an extra 20% discount from 9:55 a.m. on February 15th to 10:05 a.m. on February 19th.

That means, you can get 52% discount for the game during the Lunar New Year Sale.

Hope you enjoy the game!

M.J.H.X. Studio
